title: Unit Event — Choices for the Future — Episode7 Getting Our Feelings Across

meta.Event Outline: Emu continues studying management with the Morinomiya Revue. While leading fulfilling days full of new connections, she learns that a threat is coming to bear on Morinomiya's Kikyogumi troupe.

rows.Line: One week later
Morinomiya Revue - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
*Inhale*
*Exhale*

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It's almost time for us to present, Suzu.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Yeah. Are you feeling nervous...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! My heart's pounding so much that I feel like it's going to jump out of my mouth!

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Hehe. I know exactly what you mean.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Even for the shows where I was the lead, I don't think I ever felt this nervous.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You too, Suzu?

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Yes, but... I also kind of like this feeling.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line:
We both did everything we could up to this point.
And I think it helps that I've made my mind up...

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: We're going to turn our idea into the right solution.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Let's go in there and blow them away with our presentation.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line:
The meeting should be starting soon.
I'll go in like normal. You enter when it's our turn to present, Otori.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay! See you then!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (That week went by so fast...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Keisuke and Shosuke taught me how to become a better speaker, and I practiced a ton with Suzu.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (So, we should be fine. We'll convince them.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We've got this...!
Meeting Room

rows.Speaker: Board Members
rows.Line: Then, that concludes today's agenda.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Chairman, would now be a good time for us to give the presentation we asked the board to hear?

rows.Speaker: Chairman
rows.Line: Yes. The floor is yours.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Board Members
rows.Line: Presentation? Was this about Kikyogumi?

rows.Speaker: Board Members
rows.Line: Yes. Byakkomachi and another student wish to present an idea that involves not disbanding them...

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: (The board is acting like we expected.)

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: (This is proof that they don't take the opinions of students seriously. They don't see a need to oppose the discussion.)

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Otori, please enter.

rows.Speaker: Emu's Voice
rows.Line: Pardon me.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nice to meet you all. My name is Emu Otori.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Thank you very much for taking time out of your busy schedules to hear our presentation today.

rows.Speaker: Board Members
rows.Line: Otori...?

rows.Speaker: Board Members
rows.Line: As in, the Otori zaibatsu...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yes. As fortune would have it, I am currently being allowed to study management here at the Morinomiya Revue.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: (I had just as much trouble believing it when we practiced together, but... She seems like a completely different person.)

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: (I mean...)

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: (She looks so dignified. She clearly has the board's attention now.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We're here today to present a plan for revitalizing Kikyogumi.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Currently, they're in a dire situation in terms of revenue and manpower.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: However, there is no arguing with the fact that they have succeeded in their primary goal of appealing to a new demographic.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: First, we'd like for you all to take a look at the data we've passed out, along with the following slide.

rows.Speaker: Board Members
rows.Line: This looks like... The attendance data for the Suzurangumi and Kikyogumi troupes?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yes. As I'm sure you're all already aware, when compared with Suzurangumi, Kikyogumi garners much more support from younger fans.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That is partially due to the troupe members being much younger overall compared to Suzurangumi. And while they have their flaws, their passion and energy more than make up for it.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Unfortunately, high ticket prices are preventing new and existing fans from attending.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We believe this is the first problem that must be remedied.

rows.Speaker: Board Members
rows.Line: Yes, but... We can't just blindly lower ticket prices since that'll result in a drop in revenue.

rows.Speaker: Board Members
rows.Line: Right... I can't imagine that it'll lead to an increase in attendance when we're already hemorrhaging star-level talent.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: All true. However...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We want you all to see this as an opportunity.

rows.Speaker: Board Members
rows.Line: An opportunity? Care to elaborate...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Of course. What we mean is...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: The spots left behind by the troupe's recent departures can be filled by some of the students at the academy.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: The skill gap between the top tier of the boys and the current troupe members is virtually nonexistent.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: In other words, the odds of seeing a significant drop in performance quality are just that low.

rows.Speaker: Board Members
rows.Line: But there may be a small drop. You can't guarantee a seamless transition...

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Of course. But any growing pains will subside with time.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: The boys will feel more motivated if they're given the chance to perform on that stage.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: The more they perform on stage, the more your students stand to grow.

rows.Speaker: Board Members
rows.Line: They may be Morinomiya students, but it still seems...

rows.Speaker: Board Members
rows.Line:
No audience would have that!
Surely you're aware that they want to see professionals perform?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yes. So, we'd lay the groundwork by making a point of it in the promotional material.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We might describe it as the trial run of a new show format featuring the best our academy has to offer.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Naturally, as this is an experiment, we'll offer tickets at lower prices. The audience should then be able to watch high-quality performances without having to shoulder any further burden.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: So long as our audiences understand the experimental nature of the endeavor, we can prevent any concerns about erosion of the Morinomiya brand.

rows.Speaker: Board Members
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: It's been challenging to get Kikyogumi's core fans to return to see shows due to how much younger they are coupled with the high ticket prices that have been set...

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Lowering prices will make it much easier for them to come back.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: We may be able to make regulars out of a young demographic that was previously unfamiliar with Morinomiya.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: This is an opportunity to make an investment for the future and expand your consumer base.

rows.Speaker: Board Members
rows.Line:
It's an intriguing idea...
But will it actually work?

rows.Speaker: Board Members
rows.Line: At the moment, people don't exactly hold Kikyogumi in high regard. Even if they began trying something new, their current reputation is likely to control the conversation.

rows.Speaker: Board Members
rows.Line: True. Your plan may not pose much risk to our branding...

rows.Speaker: Board Members
rows.Line: But some fans will undoubtedly be against this.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: As for them...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (We can't guarantee success.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We still believe this idea is worth putting into practice.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: There is no right answer to this problem.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But doing nothing is not an option.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Which is why you all must choose how you're going to blaze a new trail in completely unfamiliar territory.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: The Kikyogumi fans believe in this troupe's future. They want to be there alongside their favorite performers as they grow...

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: They do not stand to lose anything from this idea.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We ask that you please give us just a small amount of time to run this experiment...!

rows.Speaker: Board Members
rows.Line: Still, we can't let students perform and risk ruining Morinomiya's reputation!

rows.Speaker: Board Members
rows.Line:
I agree...
And even if we see an increase in attendance, we can't expect stable earnings...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (We knew this wasn't going to be easy...)

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: (But we can't give up. Not now. Not yet.)

rows.Speaker: Board Members
rows.Line: Actually, I think the benefits outweigh the risks...

rows.Speaker: Board Members
rows.Line: I agree... At the very least, something just doesn't seem right about disbanding the troupe right away.

rows.Speaker: Board Members
rows.Line: Yes, and trying out a new system may get people talking...

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: They seem genuinely interested.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: I think we managed to get through to them...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Y-Yeah...!
